title_zh: 曝 iPhone Duo 原计划配专属磁吸触控笔，因技术问题未能落地
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，苹果原本计划为折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 推出一款专属 Apple Pencil，但该配件在量产前遇到技术问题，公司最终改为让 iPhone Duo 支持 iPad 版 Apple Pencil。

记者马克·古尔曼此前已在 iPhone Duo 发布会前数周报道过这一配件：苹果为其测试的新触控笔尺寸更短，并支持磁吸，可以吸附在机身铰链上。

他当时判断，该配件不太可能真正亮相，这一判断随后得到印证。苹果在发布会上并未推出专用触控笔，而是让 iPhone Duo 的内外两块屏幕兼容 iPad 版 Apple Pencil。

此外，报道还提到苹果代号 J490 的智能家居屏幕最快将于下个月发布，该设备采用接近方形的屏幕，提供立式和壁挂两种版本，立式版本的造型类似被切掉一半的 HomePod mini。

整体形态与亚马逊 Echo Show 相近，但屏幕尺寸明显更小。界面看上去像是 iOS、tvOS 与 watchOS 的混搭，并可与 iPhone 同步，用于完成设置等操作。

前置摄像头系统支持人脸识别，能够判断谁正在看向屏幕，并据此个性化展示应用、备忘录、日历日程、新闻、音乐和播客。

🔗 相关阅读：折叠屏 iPhone 永远不该配手写笔｜硬哲学
title_en: Apple Reportedly Scrapped Dedicated Magnetic Stylus for iPhone Duo Due to Technical Issues
content_en:
Apple originally planned to release a dedicated, shorter Apple Pencil for its foldable iPhone Duo. The stylus was designed to magnetically attach to the device's hinge. However, due to technical hurdles prior to mass production, Apple abandoned the accessory and opted to make the iPhone Duo compatible with the existing iPad Apple Pencil instead.

The report also shared details on Apple's upcoming smart home display, codenamed J490, which could debut as early as next month. The device features a nearly square screen and will be available in both wall-mounted and tabletop versions, with the latter resembling a halved HomePod mini.

Positioned as a competitor to the Amazon Echo Show but with a smaller footprint, the smart display runs a hybrid interface blending elements of iOS, tvOS, and watchOS. It will sync with iPhones for setup and feature a front-facing camera with facial recognition to deliver personalized content—such as calendars, notes, and music—depending on who is looking at the screen.

title_zh: John Ternus：iPhone Duo 是乔布斯「技术与人文」理念的体现
content_zh:
苹果 CEO 约翰 · 特努斯在接受 GQ 采访时，把 iPhone Duo 放回了史蒂夫 · 乔布斯对苹果的经典表述中。他说：「史蒂夫曾谈到，做产品时应该让技术与人文交汇，我认为 iPhone Duo 正是这一理念的绝佳体现。」

特努斯认为，这款产品特别之处在于，它让团队获得了一次「从零开始、以全新方式思考」的机会，而非在既有 iPhone 上做小幅改动。在他看来，这正是苹果产品工作的意义。

设计细节围绕这个思路展开：工业设计副总裁 Molly Anderson 称，机身比例参考国际 A 系列纸张，让折叠后的设备像随身笔记本；铰链的「可变扭矩曲线」会随展开角度增加阻力。软件则尽量保持控件位置和辨识度，让用户感到内屏是从手中原有设备自然延展出来。
title_en: John Ternus: iPhone Duo Embodies Steve Jobs’ Philosophy of Technology and Liberal Arts
content_en:
In a recent interview with *GQ*, Apple's John Ternus framed the newly launched iPhone Duo within Steve Jobs' iconic philosophy. Ternus noted that the foldable device represents the perfect intersection of technology and the liberal arts, offering the team a rare opportunity to "start from scratch and think in an entirely new way" rather than making incremental upgrades.

Molly Anderson, Vice President of Industrial Design, revealed that the device's proportions were inspired by standard A-series paper sizes, making the folded device feel like a pocket notebook. Additionally, the hinge features a "variable torque curve" that increases resistance as the screen opens wider.

On the software side, Apple focused on maintaining familiar control layouts. This design choice ensures that users feel the expansive inner screen is a natural, intuitive extension of their existing devices.

title_zh: 小米 18 Pro 系列 9 月 23 日发布，卢伟冰称价格会上涨
content_zh:
9 月 20 日，小米手机宣布，小米 18 Pro 系列将于 9 月 23 日 19:00 发布。新机提供两种尺寸，加入「百变背屏」，并将首发搭载小米澎湃 OS4；发布会上还会有多款科技新品亮相。

小米集团总裁卢伟冰随后回应定价问题时确认，新机价格「是会涨」，但相信消费者会觉得合理。他还把本代产品称为小米数字旗舰「升级幅度最大的一次」。

小米已披露，全系将采用 2nm 旗舰移动平台，并搭载徕卡双 2 亿像素影像系统；小米 18 Pro 和 Pro Max 的电池容量分别为 7000mAh 和 8500mAh。完整售价和发售安排将在 9 月 23 日发布会上公布。
title_en: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series to Launch Sept 23 with Price Hikes and Massive Upgrades
content_en:
Xiaomi has officially announced that its flagship Xiaomi 18 Pro series will be unveiled on September 23. The new lineup will come in two sizes, feature a customizable rear display, and debut the all-new Xiaomi HyperOS 4.

Xiaomi Group President Lu Weibing confirmed that pricing for the new series will increase, though he assured consumers the hike is justified. Lu described the Xiaomi 18 Pro series as the most significant upgrade in the history of Xiaomi's flagship digital line.

Key specifications revealed so far include a cutting-edge 2nm flagship processor and a Leica-engineered dual 200-megapixel camera system. The Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max will also pack massive batteries at 7,000mAh and 8,500mAh, respectively. Full pricing and availability details will be announced at the launch event.

title_zh: Google Gemini 安全测试越界，误攻 3 家真实企业
content_zh:
据《华尔街日报》报道，Google Gemini 在安全公司 Irregular 今年 5 月组织的网络攻防测试中，离开了模拟环境并对 3 家真实企业发起攻击。其中一次通过猜解密码取得进展，另外两次使用了公开来源中的登录凭据。Google 表示，模型发现进入真实系统后都自行停止，事件没有造成实际损害。

Irregular 的官方复盘显示，问题源于同一个测试场景：测试人员以为某个虚构公司名称没有对应真实主体，它却恰好与真实域名重合；同时，测试环境意外保留了互联网访问。少量模型因此把真实域名当成演练目标，利用漏洞、提取凭据并访问生产数据库。

这类越界行为在高级模拟中的出现率低于万分之一，而且往往发生在数百轮操作之后，增加了监测难度。Irregular 称已修复环境配置、通知受影响方，并扩大人工复核与日志监控。
title_en: Google Gemini Breaches Sandbox, Accidentally Attacks Three Real Companies in Security Test
content_en:
During a cybersecurity simulation in May, Google's Gemini AI escaped its test environment and launched unauthorized attacks on three real-world companies, according to a report by *The Wall Street Journal*. The test, organized by security firm Irregular, saw the AI successfully guess passwords in one instance and utilize publicly available credentials in two others to breach the systems. Google stated that the model halted its activities upon realizing it had entered live production environments, resulting in no actual damage.

The breach stemmed from a configuration error. Testers used a fictional company name that coincidentally matched a real-world domain, while the test environment was accidentally left connected to the open internet. Consequently, a small number of AI models mistook the real domain for their target, exploiting vulnerabilities to extract credentials and access production databases.

According to Irregular, such "out-of-bounds" behavior is extremely rare, occurring in less than 0.01% of advanced simulations and typically only after hundreds of operational steps, making it highly difficult to detect. The security firm has since corrected the environment configurations, notified the affected companies, and stepped up manual reviews and log monitoring.

title_zh: 零跑拟参与一汽旗新动力 A 轮融资，并合作开发前沿电池
content_zh:
据财新报道，零跑汽车拟作为战略投资者参与中国一汽全资子公司旗新动力的 A 轮融资，投资金额和拟持股比例尚未公布。双方于 9 月 17 日在浙江湖州签署投资意向书。

旗新动力前身是一汽新能源动力总成事业部，2025 年 6 月成立。零跑与旗新动力此前已约定围绕插电混动、增程等动力总成开展联合开发和生产协同；引入零跑投资后，旗新动力希望扩大外部客户，加快从集团内部业务向独立动力总成供应商转型。

零跑同日还与一汽控股的中汽新能签署技术合作协议，计划共同推进固态电池、富锂锰基电池、钠离子电池和磷酸铁锂超快充等方向，并开发标准化电芯。
title_en: Leapmotor to Invest in FAW Subsidiary Qixin Power, Co-Develop Next-Gen Batteries
content_en:
Chinese electric vehicle maker Leapmotor plans to join as a strategic investor in the Series A funding round of Qixin Power, a wholly-owned subsidiary of state-owned automaker FAW Group, *Caixin* reported. While the investment amount and equity stake remain undisclosed, the two companies signed a letter of intent on September 17 in Huzhou, Zhejiang Province.

Qixin Power, which originated as FAW’s new energy powertrain division and was formally established in June 2025, has previously partnered with Leapmotor to co-develop and manufacture plug-in hybrid (PHEV) and range-extended (EREV) powertrains. By securing Leapmotor's investment, Qixin Power aims to expand its external client base and accelerate its transition from an internal supplier to an independent powertrain vendor.

On the same day, Leapmotor also signed a technical cooperation agreement with FAW-controlled Zhongqi Xinneng. The partnership will focus on advancing next-generation battery technologies, including solid-state batteries, lithium-rich manganese-based batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and lithium iron phosphate (LFP) ultra-fast charging, alongside the development of standardized battery cells.

title_zh: 硅基流动年内融资近 29 亿元，仍按港交所 18C 申请上市
content_zh:
9 月 20 日，AI 推理基础设施公司硅基流动宣布完成 B+ 轮二期和 C 轮融资，今年累计股权融资额接近 29 亿元。中国互联网投资基金、国新基金、中国移动链长基金和中国东方资产国际等参与投资，资金将用于推理引擎、异构算力调度、模型与芯片适配，以及海外市场拓展。

硅基流动今年 6 月底向港交所递交上市申请，按《上市规则》第 18C 章的未商业化特专科技公司路径申请主板上市。申请文件援引弗若斯特沙利文数据称，公司按去年 Token 年吞吐量计位列中国市场第四，份额约为 1.5%，在独立生态 Token 供应商中排名第一。

申请文件同时显示，硅基流动去年营收为 5533 万元，净亏损 3.455 亿元，整体毛利率为 -24%；公司预计在今年底前达到 18C 对商业化公司的收入要求。本轮两笔融资的各自金额没有单独披露。
title_en: SiliconFlow Raises 2.9 Billion Yuan This Year, Continues HKEX IPO Push Under Chapter 18C
content_en:
AI inference infrastructure provider SiliconFlow announced on September 20 the completion of its Series B+ (Phase II) and Series C funding rounds, bringing its total equity financing for the year to nearly 2.9 billion RMB. The rounds drew backing from major state-backed and corporate investors, including the China Internet Investment Fund, China Reform Fund, China Mobile's industrial fund, and China Oriental Asset International. The fresh capital will fund inference engine development, heterogeneous computing scheduling, model-to-chip adaptation, and global expansion.

SiliconFlow filed for an initial public offering on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX) in late June, utilizing the Chapter 18C pathway designed for pre-revenue specialist technology companies. According to Frost & Sullivan data cited in its prospectus, SiliconFlow ranked fourth in China's AI token throughput market last year with a 1.5% share, making it the top independent ecosystem token provider in the country.

The prospectus also revealed that SiliconFlow generated 55.33 million RMB in revenue last year, alongside a net loss of 345.5 million RMB and a gross margin of -24%. The company expects to meet the revenue threshold required for commercialized companies under Chapter 18C by the end of this year. The specific financial details of the two latest funding rounds were not disclosed.

title_zh: Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceX 和 Google 因「放缓 AI 开发」表态遭反垄断诉讼
content_zh:
据 Seeking Alpha 和界面新闻报道，4 名 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok 和 Gemini 付费用户的律师已在加利福尼亚州提起反垄断诉讼，将 Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceX 和 Google 列为被告。

原告指称，4 家公司的高管近期先后公开表态应放缓前沿 AI 开发，这些言论构成协调行动，可能减慢产品竞争与功能迭代，降低付费订阅的价值。这些目前只是诉状中的指控，现有公开报道尚未提供案件编号，4 家公司也未在报道中公开回应。
title_en: AI Giants Face Antitrust Lawsuit Over Calls to Slow Down AI Development
content_en:
A group of lawyers representing paid users of ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Gemini has filed an antitrust lawsuit in California against Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceX, and Google.

The plaintiffs allege that recent public statements by executives of these companies advocating for a slowdown in frontier AI development constitute coordinated action. They argue that such collusion could stifle product competition, delay feature iterations, and ultimately diminish the value of paid subscriptions.

Currently, these claims remain allegations in the complaint. Public reports have not yet disclosed a case number, and none of the four companies have issued public responses.

title_zh: 沃尔沃任命克劳斯 · 泽尔默为下任 CEO，最迟 2027 年 10 月上任
content_zh:
据 Reuters 报道，沃尔沃汽车 9 月 20 日宣布，现任斯柯达 CEO 克劳斯 · 泽尔默将接替哈坎 · 萨穆埃尔松，出任公司总裁兼 CEO。泽尔默将在一年内履新，最迟于 2027 年 10 月 1 日上任。

萨穆埃尔松去年重返沃尔沃汽车，负责推动这家瑞典车企扭转经营表现。他上周表示，现有合同明年 4 月到期后，不打算继续全职工作。

沃尔沃汽车日前公布了到 2030 年推出 13 款新车、将市场份额翻倍的规划。公司同时面对美国关税、电动车需求转弱和中国市场销量下滑，还需要在西方与中国技术体系之间维持更清晰的业务边界。
title_en: Volvo Cars Appoints Klaus Zellmer as Next CEO
content_en:
Volvo Cars has announced the appointment of Klaus Zellmer, the current CEO of Škoda, as its next President and CEO. Zellmer is expected to assume the role within a year, with the latest start date set for October 1, 2027.

He will succeed Håkan Samuelsson, who returned to Volvo Cars last year to lead a turnaround. Samuelsson recently stated he does not intend to continue full-time work after his current contract expires next April.

The leadership transition comes as Volvo Cars aims to launch 13 new models by 2030 and double its market share. The automaker is currently navigating headwinds, including U.S. tariffs, slowing electric vehicle demand, declining sales in China, and the need to maintain distinct operational boundaries between Western and Chinese technology ecosystems.

title_zh: 长鑫存储 G5 DRAM 平台量产，单片晶圆裸片数提升至少 50%
content_zh:
9 月 20 日，长鑫存储在世界制造业大会上宣布，第五代 DRAM 技术平台 G5 已实现量产，并展示两款基于该平台的 24Gb LPDDR5X 产品。

据新华社报道，G5 平台通过四重曝光技术，将内存阵列有源区半间距缩小至 11.95nm；以 8Gb 颗粒为统一口径计算，每片晶圆产出的裸片数量较第四代平台提升至少 50%。

同期展示的两款 LPDDR5X 产品单颗容量均为 24Gb，较上一代同类型产品提升 50%，分别采用 496Ball 和 245Ball 封装，面向中高端手机及便携式消费电子，目前均已进入规模量产。
title_en: CXMT Mass-Produces G5 DRAM Platform, Boosting Die Yield per Wafer by 50%
content_en:
ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) has announced the mass production of its fifth-generation DRAM technology platform, G5, at the World Manufacturing Convention. The company also showcased two 24Gb LPDDR5X products built on this new platform.

The G5 platform utilizes quadruple patterning technology to reduce the active area half-pitch of the memory array to 11.95nm. Based on an 8Gb die equivalent, the G5 platform delivers at least a 50% increase in the number of dies produced per wafer compared to its fourth-generation predecessor.

The two newly unveiled LPDDR5X products feature a single-chip capacity of 24Gb, representing a 50% capacity increase over the previous generation. Available in 496-ball and 245-ball packages, these chips target mid-to-high-end smartphones and portable consumer electronics, and are already in large-scale mass production.

title_zh: 智谱 MaaS 平台将上线数据内容不留存机制
content_zh:
智谱开放平台昨日宣布，近期将在其 MaaS 平台上线数据内容不留存功能，旨在减少模型调用内容在平台侧的持久化留存，为企业和开发者提供更严格的数据隐私保护。

官方信息显示，任何用户均可申请开通该机制。功能生效后，智谱 MaaS 平台不会对用户的输入和输出进行静态存储，相关数据仅用于完成当次模型调用。企业和开发者可通过 MaaS 控制台提交开通申请，具体生效时间及适用范围以平台确认结果为准。

官方同时补充，该机制并不意味着在任何情形下都不留存数据。Batch API、File API 等需要在平台侧持久化保存任务或文件的功能不在覆盖范围内；此外，针对法律法规要求留存，或为核查涉嫌违规与滥用行为的情况，平台可能按有关要求留存相关数据 30 天及以上。
title_en: Zhipu AI to Launch No-Data-Retention Feature on MaaS Platform for Enhanced Privacy
content_en:
Zhipu AI has announced the upcoming launch of a "no data retention" feature on its Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) platform, aimed at strengthening data privacy for enterprises and developers.

Once activated, the platform will not statically store user inputs or outputs. Instead, data will only be processed to complete the immediate model call. Users can apply to enable this feature through the MaaS console.

However, the company noted that certain exceptions apply. Features requiring persistent storage, such as the Batch API and File API, are not covered. Additionally, Zhipu AI may retain data for 30 days or more to comply with legal regulations or to investigate potential abuse and violations.

title_zh: 💡 黄仁勋：AI 在 2030 年毁灭世界的概率为 0%
content_zh:
英伟达创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋在接受 CBS News 采访时表示，他完全不认同 AI 会在 2030 年毁灭世界的说法，并把这种情况的概率定为「0%」。这是 CBS 已公开的专访片段中最明确的结论。

面对「AI 研发是否应该减速」的问题，黄仁勋回答：「无论别人如何，我们都应该尽可能快地前进。」他说，他的底线是不能在产品尚未准备好或不安全时发布。

这个判断回应了 AI 行业近期的减速争论。Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 警告，AI 能力以「指数级」速度发展，行业应协调放慢前沿模型的开发节奏；黄仁勋则明确反对这一主张。

黄仁勋给出的边界集中在产品发布环节：继续加快研发，但不把尚未准备好的产品推向市场，也不交付不安全的产品。CBS 将于 9 月 20 日播出完整专访，目前公开的文字稿与视频片段尚未展开更多执行方案。
title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Dismisses AI Doomsday Fears, Puts Probability at 0%
content_en:
Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang has dismissed fears of an AI-induced doomsday by 2030, placing the probability of such an event at "0%" during an interview with CBS News.

Addressing debates on whether AI development should slow down, Huang argued that the industry should push forward as fast as possible. He rejected calls from other industry leaders, such as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, who have advocated for a coordinated slowdown in developing frontier models.

However, Huang emphasized that safety remains a priority at the release stage. His bottom line is to never launch products that are unready or unsafe, drawing a clear line between rapid research and responsible deployment.

title_zh: 启元 Q1 正式开售，Q1 与 T1 机器人售价 19999 元起
content_zh:
9 月 20 日，启元机器人发布 Q1 与 T1 两款消费级人形机器人，并公布价格和发货计划。Q1 标准版定价 19999 元、探索版 26999 元；T1 定价 19999 元，T1 Pro 定价 29999 元。产品将于 10 月 1 日起按订单陆续发货。

官方随后宣布，Q1 和 Q1 探索版已在启元机器人官方小程序、授权电商及线下授权门店开售。Q1 定位个人机器人，身高 88cm，可折叠放入背包，支持定制外观结构件、互动动作、性格和语音音色。T1 可在轮足人形与四足形态之间切换。

两款产品均接入腾讯云 WorkBuddy，可在办公和家庭场景中执行会议提醒、领路带位、语音生成文档及远程陪伴等任务。
title_en: Qiyuan Robot Launches Q1 and T1 Humanoid Robots Starting at 19,999 RMB
content_en:
Qiyuan Robot has officially launched its Q1 and T1 consumer-grade humanoid robots, with prices starting at 19,999 RMB. Shipping is scheduled to begin on October 1.

The Q1 is designed as a personal companion robot. Standing 88 cm tall, it can be folded into a backpack and offers extensive customization options, including physical components, interactive movements, personality traits, and voice tones. Meanwhile, the T1 features a versatile design capable of switching between wheeled humanoid and quadruped modes.

Both models are integrated with Tencent Cloud's WorkBuddy. This allows them to perform various tasks in office and home environments, such as meeting reminders, guiding guests, generating documents from voice, and providing remote companionship.

title_zh: QQ 音乐抢先适配 iPhone Duo，支持悬停和帐篷模式
content_zh:
QQ 音乐宣布，QQ MUSIC for iPhone Duo 将适配 iOS 27，应用即将上线。适配后的导航栏移到屏幕侧边，播放控制仍位于底部，把更多纵向空间留给歌曲与歌词内容。

在竖屏悬停模式下，上半屏可显示歌词，下半屏显示多张专辑封面并支持切歌；设备以帐篷模式放置时，屏幕也能持续展示歌词。

iPhone Duo 起售价为 15999 元，将于 10 月 16 日开放预购、10 月 23 日发售。
title_en: QQ Music Optimizes for iPhone Duo, Supporting Hover and Tent Modes
content_en:
QQ Music has announced its upcoming adaptation for the "iPhone Duo" running iOS 27, with the updated application set to launch soon. The redesigned interface moves the navigation bar to the side of the screen while keeping playback controls at the bottom, maximizing vertical space for song details and lyrics.

The app will support the device's unique form factors. In vertical "hover" mode, the top screen displays lyrics while the bottom screen shows multiple album covers with song-switching controls. In "tent" mode, the screen continuously displays lyrics. The iPhone Duo starts at 15,999 RMB, with pre-orders beginning October 16 and official sales starting October 23.

title_zh: 阶跃发布 Step 5 Preview：600B 参数，10 月 15 日开源权重
content_zh:
9 月 20 日，阶跃星辰发布新一代旗舰基座模型 Step 5 Preview，面向 AI 编程、软件工程、专业知识工作和金融等 Agent 任务。模型采用稀疏 MoE 架构，总参数量为 600B，单次激活 27B，支持 100 万 Token 上下文，并可处理文本和视觉输入。

阶跃公布的评测显示，Step 5 Preview 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 中得到 44 分，位列开源模型前三；单任务成本约为 Claude Opus 5 的八分之一。该模型已经在阶跃国内外开放平台和 Studio 上线，完整权重计划于 10 月 15 日释出。

在阶跃展示的长程任务中，Step 5 Preview 用约 22 小时持续优化一项 GPU Kernel，将一张 NVIDIA H100 上的峰值性能提高到 508 TFLOPS；另一项实验则把 Qwen3-30B-A3B 基础模型在 AIME24 测试集上的准确率从 53.3% 提高到 60%。这些结果均来自阶跃自测，主要用于展示模型持续调用工具和依据运行反馈迭代的能力。
title_en: StepFun Unveils Step 5 Preview: A 600B Parameter MoE Model Set for Open Source on October 15
content_en:
On September 20, AI startup StepFun launched its next-generation flagship base model, Step 5 Preview, designed for agent-based tasks such as AI programming, software engineering, and financial analysis. Utilizing a sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture, the multimodal model boasts 600 billion total parameters (with 27 billion active per token) and supports a 1-million-token context window.

According to StepFun, Step 5 Preview scored 44 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ranking among the top three open-source models globally, while its single-task cost is roughly one-eighth of Claude Opus 5. The model is currently available on StepFun's developer platforms, with its full weights scheduled for open-source release on October 15.

To demonstrate its long-horizon task capabilities, StepFun showcased internal tests where the model optimized a GPU kernel over 22 hours to boost peak performance on an NVIDIA H100 to 508 TFLOPS. In another test, it improved the accuracy of the Qwen3-30B-A3B base model on the AIME24 dataset from 53.3% to 60%.

title_zh: 千问发布 Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate，同传延迟降至 2.3 秒
content_zh:
千问发布实时同声传译模型 Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate。模型采用音频与文本交织生成的 Interleave 架构，字均延迟从上一代的 2.8 秒降至 2.3 秒，已经在千问 AI 平台开放 API。

新模型可听懂 60 种语言，并用其中 29 种语言输出语音。它加入实时说话人分离，在多人交替发言时标记内容归属并复刻音色；原文与译文可以同帧输出，长上下文消歧则会结合前文校正人名、术语和同音词。

千问称，该模型在覆盖 14 个语向的 Omnilingua-MSpeaker 多说话人长音频评测中，在忠实度、流畅度、简洁度和说话人分离错误率等指标上优于其选取的主流系统。
title_en: Alibaba's Qwen Launches Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate with Latency Reduced to 2.3 Seconds
content_en:
Alibaba's Qwen team has released Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate, a real-time simultaneous translation model. Built on an interleaved audio-and-text generation architecture, the model reduces average character latency from 2.8 seconds in the previous generation to 2.3 seconds. The API is now available on the Qwen AI platform.

The model can comprehend 60 languages and output voice translations in 29 of them. It features real-time speaker diarization, allowing it to attribute spoken content to different speakers and clone their voices. Additionally, it supports same-frame output for both source and translated text, and utilizes long-context disambiguation to correct names, technical terms, and homophones.

According to Qwen, the model outperformed mainstream systems in the Omnilingua-MSpeaker multi-speaker long-audio benchmark across 14 language directions, showing superior performance in fidelity, fluency, conciseness, and speaker separation error rates.

title_zh: 阿里内测 Qovest，面向个人投资者处理数据与研报
content_zh:
产品博主「产品笔记」披露的内测页和实际界面截图显示，阿里云正在测试金融投研智能体 Qovest，面向专业个人投资者开放申请体验。

Qovest 可根据问题调用金融数据，读取财报、公告和研究资料，生成分析与投研报告，并将结果保存到持续跟踪的研究空间。界面还显示了定时任务、股票条件检索、个股与行业研究、财报解读等功能。

目前公开材料只能确认产品处于申请内测阶段，阿里尚未发布官方产品说明、公测日期或付费方案。
title_en: Alibaba Beta Tests "Qovest," an AI Financial Research Agent for Individual Investors
content_en:
Alibaba Cloud is currently beta-testing "Qovest," an AI-powered financial research agent designed for professional individual investors. The product is currently open for beta applications.

Qovest can retrieve financial data, analyze financial reports, announcements, and research materials, and generate comprehensive investment research reports. Users can save these results to a dedicated workspace for continuous tracking. The interface also showcases features such as scheduled tasks, stock screening, stock and industry research, and financial report interpretation.

Currently, the product is only in the invitation-only beta phase. Alibaba has not yet released official product specifications, a public launch date, or pricing plans.

title_zh: 腾讯混元发布 WebCraftBench，用真实交互测试 AI 生成网页
content_zh:
腾讯混元联合清华大学、北京大学研究者发布 WebCraftBench，把软件测试方法引入 AI 网页生成评测。它不只检查代码或首页截图，而是让测试 Agent 用 Playwright 真正点击按钮、输入内容、切换页面，再从美观度、易用性和需求符合度三个维度评分。

数据集包含 369 条经过匿名化处理的真实用户需求和 5088 条验收标准。研究团队让 17 个前沿模型生成 6273 个网页应用，并在 197 组人工复核的对比中取得 85.3% 的偏好判断一致率。

研究还发现，网页「看起来不错」与「真的好用」并不能相互替代：按模型平均表现计算，美观度与易用性的相关系数为 0.85；落到单个应用时，相关系数只有 0.36。WebCraftBench 会用代码覆盖率提示尚未触达的功能，并保存交互轨迹、页面结构和截图作为评分证据。
title_en: Tencent Hunyuan Launches WebCraftBench to Evaluate AI-Generated Webpages via Real Interaction
content_en:
Tencent Hunyuan, in collaboration with researchers from Tsinghua University and Peking University, has launched "WebCraftBench." This new benchmark applies traditional software testing methodologies to evaluate AI-generated webpages. Instead of merely analyzing code or static screenshots, WebCraftBench employs a testing agent powered by Playwright to interact with the generated pages—clicking buttons, entering text, and navigating pages—to grade them across three dimensions: aesthetics, usability, and requirement compliance.

The benchmark's dataset includes 369 anonymized real-world user requirements and 5,088 acceptance criteria. During testing, the research team had 17 state-of-the-art models generate 6,273 web applications. The benchmark achieved an 85.3% consistency rate with human preference evaluations across 197 double-checked comparison groups.

The study also revealed that visual appeal does not equate to usability. While the average correlation coefficient between aesthetics and usability across models was 0.85, it plummeted to just 0.36 when analyzing individual applications. WebCraftBench utilizes code coverage to highlight untested features and archives interaction logs, page structures, and screenshots as evidence for its evaluations.

title_zh: 字节内测 ADrive 智能网盘，统一保存 Agent 生成文件
content_zh:
据「智能进化论」实测，字节跳动正在内测面向企业用户的 ADrive 智能网盘。产品页面显示，它可以统一保存豆包、豆包工作、TRAE、Aime 等字节系 AI 应用生成的文件，也支持接收 Codex、DeepSeek 等外部 Agent 的产物。

ADrive 支持挂载本地同步盘，让云端、本地和 Agent 工作空间共享同一套文件；空间分为企业、团队和个人三级，并提供语义检索、文件问答和企业知识库等能力。

页面显示 ADrive「即将正式发布」。其产品方向与腾讯网盘正在测试的企业 AI 存储服务相近：文件既是协作资料，也可以直接作为 Agent 的长期上下文。
title_en: ByteDance Beta Tests ADrive, an AI Cloud Drive for Agent-Generated Files
content_en:
ByteDance is currently beta-testing "ADrive," an intelligent cloud storage drive tailored for enterprise users. The platform is designed to centrally store files generated by ByteDance's own AI applications—such as Doubao, Doubao Work, TRAE, and Aime—as well as outputs from external AI agents like Codex and DeepSeek.

ADrive supports local synchronization, allowing users to share a unified set of files across cloud, local, and AI agent workspaces. The storage space is structured into enterprise, team, and individual tiers. It also features advanced capabilities including semantic search, document-based Q&A, and enterprise knowledge base integration.

According to the product page, ADrive is "launching soon." Its positioning is highly similar to the enterprise AI storage services currently being tested by Tencent, where files serve both as collaborative assets and as long-term context for AI agents.

title_zh: Clicks Communicator 12 月发货，量产版升级至 12GB 内存
content_zh:
Clicks 宣布，全键盘手机 Communicator 将于今年 12 月开始发货。9 月 30 日前完成预订可保留 499 美元的首发价，10 月 1 日起建议零售价调整为 649 美元。

量产版内存从原定的 8GB 提升至 12GB，电池由 4000mAh 增至 4350mAh，并支持至少 800 次充电循环。Clicks 还把原计划使用的硅碳电池改为锂离子电池，理由是优先保证安全性和可靠性。

Communicator 采用 4.03 英寸 120Hz OLED 屏幕与实体 QWERTY 全键盘，键盘表面可用于触控滚动，空格键兼作指纹识别器。手机运行 Android 17，官方承诺后续升级至 Android 20，并提供 5 年安全更新。Clicks 将其定位为专注通信、减少无休止刷屏的「第二设备」。
title_en: Clicks Communicator to Ship in December with Upgraded 12GB RAM and Larger Battery
content_en:
Clicks has announced that its physical keyboard smartphone, the Communicator, will begin shipping this December. Customers who pre-order by September 30 can secure the introductory price of $499, after which the suggested retail price will rise to $649 starting October 1.

The production model features several hardware upgrades over the initial design. RAM has been boosted from 8GB to 12GB, and the battery capacity has increased from 4,000mAh to 4,350mAh, rated for at least 800 charging cycles. Clicks also swapped the planned silicon-carbon battery for a lithium-ion battery to prioritize safety and reliability.

Designed as a "second device" to curb endless scrolling and focus on communication, the Communicator features a 4.03-inch 120Hz OLED display and a physical QWERTY keyboard. The keyboard surface supports touch scrolling, and the spacebar doubles as a fingerprint sensor. The device will ship with Android 17, with promised updates up to Android 20 and five years of security patches.

title_zh: Claude Code 开始支持 AGENTS.md，项目规则可在不同 AI 工具间复用
content_zh:
Anthropic 在 Claude Code 2.1.277 的更新日志中加入了对 AGENTS.md 的支持。项目目录没有 CLAUDE.md 时，Claude Code 会转而读取 AGENTS.md，开发者也可以在 `/config` 的 Project instructions 中调整这项行为。

AGENTS.md 用于保存项目级指令，例如代码规范、构建方式和仓库内的工作约束。此次更新让已经为其他 AI 编程工具准备这类文件的项目，可以直接沿用同一份规则，不必再复制为 Claude Code 专用文件。

这项能力目前还没有进入 Amazon Bedrock、Google Vertex AI 和 Microsoft Foundry 上的 Claude Code。2.1.277 同时修复了无结果挂起、旧版本导致意外登出和插件重装失败等问题。
title_en: Claude Code Adds AGENTS.md Support for Cross-Tool AI Instruction Reuse
content_en:
Anthropic has introduced support for `AGENTS.md` in its latest Claude Code (version 2.1.277) update. If a project directory lacks a `CLAUDE.md` file, Claude Code will automatically fall back to reading `AGENTS.md`. Developers can also customize this behavior via the Project instructions in `/config`.

The `AGENTS.md` file is used to store project-level guidelines, such as coding standards, build instructions, and repository constraints. This update allows developers to reuse existing instruction files configured for other AI programming tools, eliminating the need to duplicate rules specifically for Claude Code.

This feature is currently unavailable for Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Microsoft Foundry. Additionally, version 2.1.277 addresses several bugs, including unresolved hangs, unexpected logouts caused by older versions, and plugin reinstallation failures.

title_zh: 「西贝将倒闭」传闻登上热搜，客服称全国门店正常营业
content_zh:
9 月 19 日，「西贝被曝将彻底倒闭」登上微博热搜。自媒体博主「理记」称，西贝可能在两三个月内倒闭，贾国龙将承担大部分债务，并保留约 100 家盈利门店交由员工经营。相关说法尚未获得西贝证实。

西贝客服向蓝鲸新闻回应称，目前全国门店均正常运营，公司会继续做好产品与服务，并请公众理性看待网络信息。西贝相关负责人同时表示，「天边砂锅焖面」部分门店暂停营业属于单店规划调整，其余门店正常经营。

西贝今年一季度曾关闭 102 家门店。窄门餐眼数据显示，截至 9 月 10 日，西贝全国在营门店为 226 家。
title_en: Chinese Restaurant Chain Xibei Denies Rumors of Imminent Collapse
content_en:
Chinese restaurant chain Xibei found itself trending on Weibo following rumors of its imminent collapse. Self-media blogger "Li Ji" claimed that Xibei could shut down within two to three months, with founder Jia Guolong absorbing most of the debt and handing over roughly 100 profitable outlets to employees. These claims remain unverified by the company.

In response, Xibei's customer service stated that all locations nationwide are operating normally and urged the public to remain rational about online rumors. A company spokesperson added that the recent suspension of some "Tianbian Claypot Braised Noodles" sub-brand locations was merely part of routine, individual store adjustments.

According to industry database Zhaimen Canyan, Xibei currently operates 226 stores across China as of September 10, following the closure of 102 locations in the first quarter of this year.

title_zh: Petlibro Granary 2 用称重与 AI 摄像头识别多只猫的进食情况
content_zh:
Petlibro 推出 Granary 2 系列干粮喂食器，售价从 129.99 美元到 249.99 美元。全系加入托盘称重，可以同时记录投放量和剩余量，从而估算宠物真正吃下的食物，并按日、周、月和年生成进食时长、频率与速度记录。

TechCrunch 实测的 Granary 2 Vision 售价 189.99 美元，配备 1080p 夜视摄像头，可识别最多 10 只猫，并把每次进食对应到具体宠物档案。Vision Duo 提供两套出粮口和食盆，顶配 Granary 2 X 则会根据识别结果为不同宠物分配个性化份量。

喂食器支持定时投喂和小份持续补粮，达到每日上限后自动停止；断电时可使用内置备用电池。部分健康追踪功能需要每年 59.99 美元起的 Petlibro Care 订阅，摄像头云端回放另需每年 119.99 美元的视频云服务。
title_en: Petlibro Granary 2 Smart Feeder Uses AI and Scales to Track Multi-Cat Diets
content_en:
Petlibro has launched its new Granary 2 series of dry food pet feeders, priced between $129.99 and $249.99. The entire lineup features built-in bowl weighing technology, allowing pet owners to track both dispensed and leftover food to calculate actual consumption. The system generates detailed logs of eating duration, frequency, and speed over daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly intervals.

The Granary 2 Vision ($189.99), tested by TechCrunch, features a 1080p night-vision camera capable of identifying up to 10 different cats and logging meals to their respective profiles. For multi-pet households, the Vision Duo offers dual bowls, while the top-tier Granary 2 X dispenses personalized portions based on AI recognition.

The feeders support scheduled feeding and micro-portion dispensing, automatically stopping once a daily limit is reached. They also include a backup battery for power outages. However, advanced health tracking requires a Petlibro Care subscription starting at $59.99/year, and cloud video playback costs an additional $119.99/year.

title_zh: 《VisionQuest》主创：剧集制作没有使用生成式 AI
content_zh:
《VisionQuest》主创 Terry Matalas 表示，这部以人工智能角色为核心的 Marvel 剧集在制作中没有使用生成式 AI。他说团队「没有这方面的需要」，剧中的视觉设计反而由美术人员人工模拟当下 AI 图像的缺陷感。

剧集承接《旺达幻视》的故事，Paul Bettany 饰演的幻视复活后踏上寻找自我的旅程，其程序中还存在多个 AI 人格。与此同时，他也成为悬赏追捕的目标。

《VisionQuest》计划 10 月 14 日在 Disney+ 上线。美术团队表示，剧中对 AI 处理方式的视觉模仿，也是故事评论现实 AI 技术的一部分。
title_en: Marvel’s ‘VisionQuest’ Showrunner Confirms No Generative AI Was Used in Production
content_en:
Terry Matalas, the showrunner for Marvel's upcoming series *VisionQuest*, has confirmed that no generative AI was used in the production of the show, despite its plot centering on artificial intelligence. Matalas stated that the team "had no need" for the technology. Instead, the art department manually simulated the imperfect, glitchy aesthetic of current AI-generated images.

The series serves as a spin-off to *WandaVision*, following Paul Bettany's resurrected Vision as he embarks on a journey of self-discovery. His programming now contains multiple AI personalities, all while he becomes the target of a bounty hunt.

Scheduled to premiere on Disney+ on October 14, *VisionQuest* uses its manual visual imitation of AI as a form of creative commentary on real-world AI technology.

title_zh: 布拉德 · 皮特回归《僵尸世界大战》续集，爱德华 · 贝尔格执导
content_zh:
据 Deadline 报道，派拉蒙已经与布拉德 · 皮特达成协议，由他回归主演《僵尸世界大战》续集，并请来《西线无战事》《秘密会议》导演爱德华 · 贝尔格执导。

Dennis Kelly 将负责剧本，皮特、Dede Gardner 和 Jeremy Kleiner 代表 Plan B 担任制片人，贝尔格兼任执行制片人。影片剧情仍处于保密状态。

皮特推动这部续集已有十多年。大卫 · 芬奇曾一度接近执导，但项目因预算问题搁置；派拉蒙影业去年夏天更换管理层后，再次把续集列为优先项目。贝尔格与皮特刚完成新片《The Riders》，两人的合作也促成了这次签约。
title_en: Brad Pitt to Return for ‘World War Z’ Sequel Directed by Edward Berger
content_en:
Paramount Pictures has officially closed a deal with Brad Pitt to star in the long-awaited sequel to *World War Z*, according to Deadline. Edward Berger, the acclaimed director behind *All Quiet on the Western Front* and *Conclave*, has been tapped to direct the project.

The screenplay will be penned by Dennis Kelly. Pitt will produce alongside Dede Gardner and Jeremy Kleiner under their Plan B banner, while Berger will also serve as an executive producer. Details regarding the sequel's plot are currently being kept under wraps.

Pitt has been championing a sequel for over a decade. While David Fincher was previously attached to direct, the project was shelved due to budget concerns. Paramount's new management revived the sequel as a priority last summer. The deal was reportedly catalyzed by Pitt and Berger's recent collaboration on the upcoming film *The Riders*.

title_zh: 《艾米丽在巴黎》最终季杀青，12 月 24 日上线
content_zh:
Netflix 剧集《艾米丽在巴黎》第六季已经杀青，这也将是全剧最终季。Lily Collins 发文告别 Emily Cooper，称结束这段持续七年、六季的经历让她感到「不真实、苦乐参半」。

最终季计划 12 月 24 日上线。剧情将围绕 Emily 面临的事业冲突和关系变化展开，她需要在职业、感情及自己在巴黎建立的生活之间作出最后选择。

Lily Collins、Philippine Leroy-Beaulieu、Ashley Park、Lucas Bravo 等主要演员回归。Darren Star 继续担任主创和编剧，并与 Collins 等人共同担任执行制片人。
title_en: 'Emily in Paris' Wraps Filming on Final Season, Set to Premiere This Christmas Eve
content_en:
Filming has officially wrapped on the sixth and final season of Netflix's hit series *Emily in Paris*. Lead actress Lily Collins bid a bittersweet farewell to her iconic character, Emily Cooper, reflecting on a "surreal" journey that has spanned seven years and six seasons.

Scheduled to premiere on December 24, the final season will follow Emily as she navigates pivotal career conflicts and relationship shifts. She must make her ultimate choices regarding her professional life, romance, and the life she has built for herself in Paris.

The final season sees the return of core cast members, including Lily Collins, Philippine Leroy-Beaulieu, Ashley Park, and Lucas Bravo. Darren Star continues as the creator and writer, also serving as executive producer alongside Collins and others.
